Hi Samantha / Brian —

Thanks again for taking time earlier to run through AlphaTech's goals around low-latency embeddings and multi-tenant inference. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

- What we heard: you want a pilot to validate 95th percentile latencies under realistic traffic (internal search traffic + nightly batch embeddings), with a focus on cost-per-query and KV cache behavior.
- Key success criteria: sub-100ms tail for short queries, cost within target, and clear metrics for regression during model swaps.
- Next step: 45m technical deep dive + infrastructure handoff with one of our inference engineers to size a dedicated pool and walk through KV/cache warmup.

Because calendars were messy on the call, I wanted to propose two options to get the deep dive scheduled (I can hold engineering time once you confirm):

1) Tue Aug 11 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT
2) Wed Aug 12 — 09:00–09:30 AM PT (shorter slot if you want a focused ops run-through)

I attached a draft SOW (Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf) with scope and typical timeline for a two-week pilot; no signatures required yet — it's just for context. If those slots don't work, toss me a couple of alternatives and I will coordinate with Mina (SE) and our infra lead.

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Marcus Lin
